flagged.evidence: The page identifies degree “with the intersection of the graph against a complementary fibre.” For the identity of the positively oriented circle, degree is 1, but in the product-oriented circle × circle the graph-first and fibre-second tangent columns are (1,1),(1,0), with determinant -1. The current example explicitly gives I(graph, fibre)=(-1)^n deg(F); fibre-first recovers degree.

flagged.location: Second summary paragraph, lines 25–28: arctangent family
flagged.evidence: For the family arctan(x)-t, the page says the count jumps “despite proper endpoints.” For every t, the compact interval [-π/2-t,π/2-t] contains the entire image, so its preimage is all of R, which is noncompact. Thus both endpoint maps are improper. The current counterexample correctly distinguishes this family from its polynomial proper-slice witness.
